mapper.sql: select st.settlement_id, st.settlement_no, st.shop_id, st.period_start, st.period_end, st.order_count, st.gross_amount, st.commission_amount, st.net_amount, st.status, st.paid_at, st.create_by, st.create_time, st.update_by, st.update_time, st.remark, sh.shop_name from shop_settlement st left join shop sh on sh.shop_id = st.shop_id
mapper.insert: insert into shop_settlement (settlement_no, shop_id, period_start, period_end, order_count, gross_amount, commission_amount, net_amount, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{settlementNo}, #{shopId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{orderCount}, #{grossAmount}, #{commissionAmount}, #{netAmount}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update shop_settlement set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where settlement_id = #{settlementId}
update shop_settlement set status = 'PAID', paid_at = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where settlement_id = #{settlementId} and status = 'PENDING'
